data.title: bn-23h: launch every suggested argv
data.description: Exact process-level acceptance for INV-31: recursively collect next and transport actions, resolve literal scourge through PATH, launch every unique argv from an unrelated directory with spaces and FORMAT absent, require one strict JSON envelope, preserve explicit workspace/engagement scope, and fail unless emitted and launched sets match. Checked-in immutable launcher positively records cwd, environment, and exact arguments. Focused suite, M1 recut, full normal-parallel just check, and diff check pass.

data.body: P1: The hard-coded seed list is not an exhaustive command/action catalog, so emitted == launched only proves the subset this test happened to discover. In a disposable exact-target archive I added a valid status suggestion to the shipped version response; the exact every_suggested_argv test still passed. That directly violates the acceptance that the harness fail when a command prints a suggestion it did not exercise. Tie the seed set to an authoritative exhaustive shipped-command/outcome catalog (including version/aliases and action-emitting error paths), and add a non-vacuity mutation showing a newly emitting command fails the harness.

P1: Post-launch scope preservation is only checked for (Some, Some). If a scoped argv is accepted but the child response drops workspace and/or engagement to None, both checks are skipped. A disposable exact-target mutation cleared both fields only in launcher-started processes (SCOURGE_ACTION_TRACE present); the focused crawler still passed. Compare the response Option values to the emitted ActionScope exactly (or otherwise require expected Some to remain Some), and retain a mutation/negative witness for scope loss.

data.reason: P1 acceptance gaps: the seed list is not exhaustive, so an unseeded shipped command can emit an unlaunched suggestion without failing; and post-launch scope comparisons skip expected Some versus actual None. Both were reproduced by isolated exact-target mutations while focused/full gates otherwise passed.

data.body: Fixed at 7c898973998fa560fcae2eae7c7bf98ca3d5211b: seeds now come from the authoritative Clap command tree, recursively including canonical commands, visible aliases, help, value-enum/argument variants, and per-command error paths. The process harness runs every generated seed both bound and unbound, and its version-response mutation witness proves a newly emitted action is incomplete until launched. A disposable production mutation adding a valid action to version was discovered and launched successfully.

Fixed at 7c898973998fa560fcae2eae7c7bf98ca3d5211b: launcher responses are compared to the action's encoded workspace and engagement as exact Option values, so Some-to-None loss fails. Collection also requires exact required action scope, with help actions explicitly unscoped. The negative witness checks both missing workspace and missing engagement.

data.reason: Resolved at 7c898973: seeds derive recursively from the authoritative Clap tree, including canonical names, visible aliases, help/error paths, arguments and visible enum values; fixture placeholder expansion fails closed on new names. In an isolated exact-target archive, adding a unique version suggestion passed when launchable, then failed when only the launcher-started version response was made nonzero, proving it was discovered and launched.

Resolved at 7c898973: ActionScope parses the exact encoded workspace/engagement Options and launcher responses must equal them, including Some-to-None presence. An isolated exact-target mutation clearing both fields only under the launcher environment now fails the crawler at the scope assertion; focused negative unit coverage also checks each missing field.

Reviewed exact 7c898973998fa560fcae2eae7c7bf98ca3d5211b over 54a567b79d7369cc2e2de4dd591b3eab239df04c. Both P1s are resolved with independent isolated mutations: a unique version suggestion is discovered/launched, and launcher-started scope loss fails. Focused entry/CLI, M1 recut, normal full just check, and exact diff check pass.
